about: The Minidex 001-251: a GBC-style party icon for every Kanto and Johto Pokémon, on an animated GIF (two frames, the icons' two poses). 16x16 icons, fifteen to a row in national order, the first at (10, 37), 34 pixels apart across and 25 down (a number label under each). The background, (218, 229, 214), is the GIF's see-through colour. Unown's one icon is used for every letter.
